# OpenVault

Clean-room Android VeraCrypt container viewer (see `docs/`). Status: M0–M2 core in progress.

```bash
tools/test.sh        # generate fixtures (first run) + run all JVM tests (Maven)
```

* `core/io`, `core/crypto`, `core/veracrypt`, `core/testkit`: pure Kotlin/JVM, built with Maven
  (Gradle cannot download from Maven Central in the dev sandbox; Gradle returns for `:app`).
* Fixtures are generated by `tools/make_fixtures.py` (independent Python implementation). Before release,
  replace/augment with containers from desktop VeraCrypt and run `tools/verify_fixtures_cryptsetup.sh`.
